$comment: The source of sf-slider's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/slider (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

button-type.summary: The arrows' look: secondary (the default, the quiet grey icon buttons: paging is no main action, decision C116; over a picture they stand on popup plates with the overlay shadow, under cards they are tonal on-surface, decision C143), primary (filled primary), dark (filled on-surface), light (ghost on-surface).

button-size.summary: The arrow buttons' size, an sf-icon-button size.

dots-type.summary: The dots' plate by its colour role. Not written (decision C143): over a picture a popup plate with the overlay shadow, under cards no plate; the dots are 8 px, the current one a 24 x 8 pill, and from eight slides a counter «2 / 12» stands in their place. Written: primary-container (a primary-container plate with on-primary-container dots), primary (a primary plate with on-primary dots), surface-container (a raised neutral plate with on-surface dots), surface-inverse (an inverse plate with on-surface-inverse dots). Former words, dated aliases until 2027-01-01: primary-dark is primary-container, primary-light is primary, light and clear are surface-container, dark is surface-inverse.

ratio.summary: The frame of a picture slider (decision C143 (8)): the slides' box keeps this ratio from the first frame, before the code arrives, so the page does not jump. auto: the slides' own height. A card slider (root-class sf-slider--content) takes its cards' height and ignores it.

change.x-summary: The shown slide changed, by an arrow, a dot, a thumbnail, a swipe or an action

refresh.x-summary: Lays the slides out again after the page changed them or their box
refresh.summary: Rebind the slider after its slides changed: forwards the data attributes and rebuilds Swiper, keeping the events bound. Returns the element.

slide-next.x-summary: Shows the next slide; refused (not-ready) before the slider has started
slide-next.summary: Move to the next slide, as the next arrow does. Returns the element.

slide-prev.x-summary: Shows the previous slide; refused (not-ready) before the slider has started
slide-prev.summary: Move to the previous slide, as the previous arrow does. Returns the element.

slide.$comment: Each child of the host is a slide, placed, never copied (§4.5).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The block is a region named by the page's aria-label, else the word Слайды / Slides, described as a carousel (aria-roledescription from the language file: карусель / carousel); each slide is a group described as a slide (слайд / slide) and named by its position (1 из 5 / 1 of 5); the strip is aria-live polite, off while autoplay turns it. The arrows are named from the language file (Предыдущий слайд, Следующий слайд). With data-swiper-keyboard on, ArrowLeft and ArrowRight page from anywhere in the block, mirrored in a right-to-left block. Tab reaches the pause button (with autoplay, first), the arrows and the dots, which are one stop: the current dot holds it and ArrowLeft / ArrowRight, Home and End move the slide and the focus (decision C143 (5)). From eight slides the counter «2 / 12» replaces the dots and is not read (the slides say their position). Autoplay (data-autoplay) turns only while the pause button is shown; it stops for good on the button or on a keyboard focus inside, and holds while the pointer is over the slider or the tab is hidden; the button is named by what it does next (Остановить прокрутку / Запустить прокрутку), never aria-pressed (C12).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-slider for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

x-summary: A row of slides moved by arrows, dots, swipe or keys, built on the shared Swiper adapter; with linked thumbnails a second slider picks the slide.
x-renamed: events.sf-slide-change → change: the DOM name is change (§8 a value a person changes); detail carries the indexes only, the element leaves it
methods.getSlider: a reader retires (§4.4), kept and noted until the date
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: sf-slide-change and getSlider are dated rows, the actions answer outcomes; a minor while they hold (§4.10).

events: the slide change is change {active-index, real-index, previous-index} (§8), DOM name change; sf-slide-change follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01. The detail carries data only: component, tagName and template leave it.
a11y-role: region on the root (sf-slider 1.3.0, SL-5), aria-roledescription carousel in the page's language; the slides are groups described as slides.
a11y-name: the root by the page's aria-label, else runtime.label (Слайды); each slide by its position from runtime.position ({n} из {count}), each arrow by its word.
number-type: button-size and dots-size are steps of the size ladder (1/2, 1, 2), not numbers; they stay strings. space-between and speed are numbers (pixels, milliseconds).
actions: refresh is the element's own relayout (it overrides the base's refresh, which §16.7 frees); slide-next and slide-prev answer refused (not-ready) before Swiper has started.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus arrows, dots and thumbnails; probe.json drives the actions, the arrows and the alias.
skeleton: none; the slides are the page's children, drawn before any code (§5.4).
css-variables: five public variables read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
version 1.1.9: the first-paint snapshot is retaken: a nested sized component now carries data-sf-size-relative at first paint (density C22, core.runtime 1.45.0); nothing it draws changes.

version 1.1.10 (2026-11-10, pair ui-a0370c0c99fb acceptance, F3): a patch. The arrows of buttons="light" are asked for appearance ghost, not link, its former name, which counted as the page's own use of sf-button-icon appearance link in SF.deprecations. Drawn the same.

version 1.1.11 (2026-11-11): an arrow with nowhere to go is a disabled button, out of the tab order, and an arrow that holds the focus hands it to the other one (component.slider 1.1.2, docs pre-check 2026-11-10 SL-04). The dots were already 24 px targets (their ::before) and are unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-10, docs precheck Q4): a minor. dots-type names the dots' plate by its colour role: primary-container (the default), primary, surface-container, surface-inverse. primary-dark, primary-light, light, clear and dark are dated value aliases until 2027-01-01 (journal value-slider-dots-type-to-roles) and draw as before. One word changes what it draws: primary, which drew as primary-dark, is now the primary plate (primary-light's look), the role it names; no page in ui-doc, larena-ui, ui-pro or ui-admin writes it.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-14, ui-control research 2026-11-14-content-slider): a minor. The arrows default to button-type secondary, the soft grey icon buttons (decision C116: paging is no main action; SL-11); primary stays a value. The block is a named region described as a carousel and its slides as slides, «1 из 5» (SL-5; words label, carousel, slide, position in lang/). A finger, a pen or the mouse drags the slides and pages past 15 % of a slide or with a flick; a vertical move scrolls the page; reduced motion settles without travel (SL-2, component.swiper 1.1.0). With data-swiper-keyboard on, ArrowLeft and ArrowRight page wherever the focus is in the block, mirrored right to left (SL-3). change carries previousIndex (SL-7). Several slides in view stand --sf-space-1/2 apart (SL-8); thumbnails take the small-part radius --sf-radius--ui (SL-12) and stand that far apart too (component.slider 1.2.0). Decision C143 (owner 2026-11-14, all eight by recommendation), in the same unreleased minor: (1) one slider: sf-slider takes sf-carousel's region name and its mandatory pause button; the class block sf-carousel is an old name until 2027-01-01 (component.carousel 1.3.0, journal class-sf-carousel-to-sf-slider). (2) Over a picture the default arrows and the dots stand on popup plates (--sf-surface-popup, --sf-shadow-overlay); an edge arrow dims its glyph and keeps its plate. (3) Under cards one row: the position at the start, the quiet grey arrows at the end, --sf-space-1/3 between them (C105 H5), --sf-space-1 between the groups (H6). (4) Dots 8 px, the current a 24 x 8 pill; from eight slides a counter «2 / 12» (component.slider). (5) The dots are one Tab stop paged by the arrow keys, Home and End (component.swiper). (6) Autoplay stays off by default and turns only with a shown pause button, which the template draws first when data-autoplay is set (words pause, play). (7) A card slider shows the next card's edge: 1.15 cards in view on a phone, 2.2 from the sm step, unless the page sets how many. (8) New setting ratio (16/9 by default): a picture slider keeps its frame from the first frame (core.styles holds sf-slider's box before its code), no more 1907 -> 381 px. A dots-type the page writes keeps its plate; dots-size no longer changes the dot (8 px in both steps). Same unreleased minor (core.runtime, gallery GL open question 1): <figure slot="slide"> with its figcaption is one slide; the base no longer unwraps a figure, a picture or an element holding a figcaption.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-slider to project the shared Slider/Swiper behavior. In the default template, root-class, author style and root-style customize the existing root; root-style wins. Cosmetic-only changes preserve the active slide, focus and Swiper instances and emit sf-updated with updateMode=dom, not slide-change. afterRender(callback) uses the base lifecycle API. The shared adapter uses navigation aria-label as default Swiper a11y messages; explicit a11y messages override them, disabled a11y remains disabled and aria-labelledby retains native precedence. Omitted space-between and speed inherit Framework spacing and duration tokens; explicit numeric attributes remain compatibility overrides. Reduced motion disables transitions and autoplay. Explicit autoplay pauses on focus and document visibility, while non-visible slides stay outside the keyboard order.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code

A slide is one meaningful slot item. Bare slot-only wrappers expose their children; attributed card roots remain whole. Whitespace-only text and comments do not become slides. Preserve composite cards inside one item; do not infer grouping from sibling headings or links.

Use existing root-class=sf-slider--content for text/card slides with controls in normal flow; default media overlay is preserved. Dot hit areas inherit semantic UI geometry from the shared Slider CSS.

Pagination inherits shared Slider CSS: inactive contour and current fill use semantic foreground roles; preserve focus-visible, forced-colors and the appropriate backdrop for transparent schemes. Do not create a Smart-only dot palette.
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

getSlider.summary: The Swiper instance behind the slider, or null before it is bound.
